payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Diagnose the real-Obsidian modal-open lifecycle before rerunning write acceptance. Two clean-source athena runs (monitors gej22x5f1vmv and njeah1bw9463) built bob-cli SHA 7703011d6df8bfd0a6a40683d1ec61a774350979, passed prerequisites, and failed identically before assertions: openPropertyEditor returned ok, but the .bob-property-editor DOM probe remained false until timeout. Both reports have zero assertions and screenshots, and no console exceptions; the offline self-test passes. A prior manual launch with the same plugin and fixture opened successfully, so no write-path defect is confirmed. Keep this phase in progress; add modal-open diagnostics or resolve the startup race, then rerun acceptance.

Continued the landed harness instead of rewriting it. Short real-Obsidian diagnostics on athena reproduced a connected modal containing editor HTML while the global document selector returned zero; later fresh-profile probes found it normally, so the startup cause remains unconfirmed. Added harness startup readiness, bounded modal lifecycle/error traces, owner-document and modal HTML diagnostics, failure PNG capture, and complete Bob invocation logs. Tightened null/empty assertions to compare value cells and press unchanged Enter with exact disk-byte checks; replaced screenshot-size gating with recorded visible-editor and PNG-dimension assertions. Four harness tests pass; npm run build and npm run validate pass; bob plugins sync reports all ledger-tools files unchanged. No epic-symbol entries remain. Full plugin tests and a fresh clean-CLI athena run are being handed to a monitor; local results will be under .git/property-editor-acceptance-results, including summary.json, property-editor-report.json, shots, npm-test.log, and athena.log. Remaining work: use that evidence to fix any real failure, obtain green write acceptance, register report/screenshots, then close only this phase.

Diagnosed startup from failureDiagnostics and inspected the failure PNG. A fresh-profile Athena probe reproduced document.hasFocus=false and Obsidian activeWindow/activeDocument pointing at about:blank; native Modal.open() explicitly appends to activeWindow.document.body. Page.bringToFront plus window.focus restored activeWindow to the real app window; a second fresh-profile probe then mounted the editor into app://obsidian.md/index.html. Added this focus step and readiness predicate to the harness, plus active-window diagnostics and a regression test that rejects both stale activeWindow and unfocused documents. All 5 harness tests pass, build:check and diff checks pass. Prior full suite had 9013 pass, 5 skipped, and only the known timing failures bob-cli-km and bob-cli-io; both affected suites pass in isolation (40/40), with all 26 serialized perf tests already green. No epic symbols remain. Failed-run files are preserved under .git/property-editor-acceptance-failed-startup; the next monitored clean-source acceptance run will replace .git/property-editor-acceptance-results. This corrects the harness startup failure; full write acceptance is still required before closing.

payload.entry: The failed wgehyg run lost focus after startup readiness. Fresh-profile probes reproduced a delayed native blur, and showed that CDP focus emulation alone makes document.hasFocus true while Obsidian activeWindow remains about:blank. The harness now reasserts Electron native window focus while polling, and verifies it immediately before every API open. It waits for the initial Bob report or typed refusal rather than accepting cached placeholder rows; a regression test covers repeated navigation and both outcomes. This exposed wrong harness expectations: safe edited text/datetimes are unquoted, new lists use block style, existing short lists remain flow, and new frontmatter adds no extra blank line per bob-cli docs/props.md and emit.rs/plan.rs. Corrected those explicit byte expectations, new tags insertion after the selected source key, the checked glyph assertion, and collection lookup beyond the first chip. A fresh-profile real-Obsidian diagnostic passed project edit, exact undo, redo, and add (5 assertions); this is partial coverage, not full acceptance. All 6 harness tests, build:check, validate and diff checks pass. Plugin sync: 34 unchanged. Previous full unit timing exceptions remain bob-cli-km and bob-cli-io, both confirmed isolated 40/40; perf 26/26. No epic symbols. Full fresh-source acceptance will run next; keep the phase open until its report and screenshots are verified and registered.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: The assigned acceptance-surfaces phase should repair the Property Editor shell styling. Both the loading and settled real-Obsidian screenshots show inline, cramped row buttons with key/value text running together; source styles.css defines stage styles but no .bob-property-row or base .bob-property-editor layout styles. Evidence inspected: .git/property-editor-first-write-native.png (loading) and .git/property-editor-first-write-settled.png (saved). This belongs to the existing child epic visual acceptance scope; no new bead was created.

Further recovery review found and reproduced a product defect: y on invalid YAML selected type at line 2 instead of Bob's error at line 4. Two failing-first entrypoint tests also proved that the selected second duplicate collapsed to the first occurrence. Fixed modal-to-excursion line propagation for duplicates and prioritized parser diagnostics over cached keys for damaged YAML. Regenerated main.js; all 69 focused tests passed. A fresh-profile real-Obsidian recovery probe then passed all 7 assertions (invalid line 4, unclosed line 1, selected duplicate line 4, plus verbatim diagnostics and Done returns). The harness now waits for the Done control rather than accepting an already-matching cursor before the async excursion starts. This joins the 5 passing real-app project assertions from the prior probe, but does not replace full acceptance. Corrected harness recovery expectations to match Bob's actual source lines. Full npm test and validate will rerun because this turn now includes a product fix. bob plugins sync deployed the updated ledger-tools main.js; all fragments remain below 1000 lines and epic-symbols is empty. Visual diagnostics are attached as file:explicit:7e12d43d0c85a1341586ae16 (loading) and file:explicit:8f50ead937709232d964a1c2 (saved). Keep the missing shell styles with the existing acceptance-surfaces phase as recorded above; full acceptance report and all final screenshots still need inspection, registration, and references before this phase closes.
